open_points.subject: public_op:clock.monotonic_ns deadline origin
open_points.text: The caller derives a bounded wait's deadline from it — the reading at the start plus the bound
open_points.question: For each caller, what event is “the start”: entry to execute_function/send_prepared_request, immediately before launching the sandbox or beginning DNS/connection work, or immediately before waiting for completion?
options: Count all work performed by execute_function or send_prepared_request from operation entry
Start immediately before launching the sandbox process or beginning transport work
Start only after setup, when waiting for execution or response completion begins
open_points.default_guess: Count from entry to execute_function or send_prepared_request, so setup, DNS, connection, sending and response receipt are inside the applicable bound.

open_points.subject: public_op:clock.monotonic_ns deadline boundary
open_points.text: asks whether it passed with a later reading
open_points.question: Is the bounded wait expired when the later reading is equal to the derived deadline, or only when it is greater?
